stories.title: Wemby Gets Revenge — France Edges Serbia 91-90 in Orleans Thriller — Tier 1

WEMBANYAMA'S REVENGE.

France 91, Serbia 90. Buzzer-beater. Orleans.

Wemby: 18 points (nearly 2x his Belgrade output).
Jokic: 34 points, 13 rebounds — still lost.

Hoard's fast-break layup sealed it with 11 seconds left. 🔥

#Wembanyama #FIBA

Basketball is wild. 🏀
